How Digital Vector HQ works

  1. Click a teammate (or their name tag). The camera flies in and their chat opens. Esc flies back out.
  2. Ask Vector for priorities, New brief to hand a task to anyone, Stand-up to gather the whole team at the round table for updates and an action list.
  3. Every teammate reads the company brief (Settings → Company) plus their own persona, which you can edit from their chat.
  4. Drag to orbit, right-drag or two fingers to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. Click the big screen to look at the studio board.
  5. The team keeps its own routine: coffee runs, lunch, TV in the lounge, the copier, the vending machine, desk visits and huddles. Click anyone wherever they are and they stop to talk. Hover a name tag to see what they're up to.

Running a local model with Ollama

1. Install Ollama, then pull a model:
ollama pull llama3.1
2. Let this page talk to it, then restart Ollama:
Windows (PowerShell): 
setx OLLAMA_ORIGINS "*"
macOS: 
launchctl setenv OLLAMA_ORIGINS "*"
Linux: 
OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" ollama serve
3. Settings → AI models → Local AI → Ollama preset → Load models → Test.

Alternative to step 2: serve this file from localhost instead of double-clicking it, e.g. python -m http.server in its folder, then open http://localhost:8000.

OpenAI or Claude

Paste your API key into its card, pick a model, press Test. The key stays in this browser.
